title: Without Replacement Changed The Second Denominator And Numerator
text: id: COMP-006 domain: math title: Without Replacement Changed The Second Denominator And Numerator tags: probability, without-replacement, fractions memory: I once missed a probability because I kept the bag unchanged after the first draw. Without replacement meant the second red count dropped and the total count dropped. The multiplication became first chance times changed second chance. The fraction looked ordinary, but the changed denominator carried the whole meaning.
